pages.title: Kitchen furniture
pages.text: Kitchen furniture and the pan use TFC inventory block entities. The mixing bowl is provided by Firmalife and remains the entry point for fluids, flour, eggs and sweeteners.

pages.title: Pan cooking
pages.text: The pan must sit above a lit TFC heat source. Add plant oil first (TFC/Firmalife oil bucket or bottle), then add up to eight food ingredients. Stir with a metal spatula; ingredients cook over time and burn if left unstirred. Take the finished dish with a plate. The number of servings equals the number of ingredients. Right-click a filled plate to eat one serving; sneak + right-click to place it. Breaking a placed dish returns the plate with its food data. A wooden or ceramic bowl can take one serving from a placed dish.

pages.title: Dough board controls
pages.text: Place a supported dough on a cutting board. The board displays: Left-click to press dough, right-click to knead dough, sneak + right-click to confirm. A recipe is produced only after confirmation. If the counts do not match a recipe, the board says that the dough has not formed yet and keeps the dough.

pages.title: Cake dough
pages.text: Mix 300 mB yeast starter, three wheat/oat/barley/rye flours, one raw egg and one sweetener in a Firmalife mixing bowl. Three presses and three kneads make an unbaked cake base; two presses and one knead make two sweet pancakes.

pages.title: Ordinary dough
pages.text: Three presses followed by confirmation makes an unbaked pizza. Four presses and two kneads followed by confirmation make the matching grain naan. Three kneads followed by a knife makes four matching grain buns.

pages.title: Oven and tools
pages.text: Use a knife for cupcakes, bagels, buns and noodles. Fifteen unbaked foods count continuous time above 400 C in a Firmalife oven; cooling below the threshold resets progress. Use one butter block on a baked cake base for a cream cake, or a Firmalife chocolate blend for a chocolate cake. The old dough forming table, melting pot, generic dough and butter slice have been removed from the current version.

pages.title: Fruit pie
pages.text: Craft a whole pie with two fruit, one sweetener and one dough in the pie pattern. The fruit tag includes TFC strawberries and classified project fruit. Rotten ingredients are rejected; TFC food data is inherited. Place the pie and right-click with an empty hand for eight servings. Placement, saving and breaking preserve food data. Rotten pies cannot be placed or served, and breaking never refreshes their slices.
